T05.topic_name: Quadratic inequalities in one variable and in two variables
T05.competency: Illustrate on number lines; solve quadratic inequalities in one variable across notations; solve quadratic inequalities in two variables; determine solution regions of systems.

questions.suggested_question: Define a quadratic inequality in one variable and write its standard forms using >, <, ≥, and ≤.
State the step-by-step procedure for solving a quadratic inequality in one variable using test intervals / sign chart method.
Solve the quadratic inequality and graph the solution on a number line: x² - 5x - 6 > 0.
Solve the quadratic inequality: x² - 7x + 12 ≤ 0. Express the solution in interval notation and set-builder notation.
Solve the quadratic inequality: 2x² + 5x - 3 ≥ 0.
Solve the quadratic inequality: 3x² - 10x + 8 < 0.
Solve the quadratic inequality: x² - 16 ≥ 0.
Solve the quadratic inequality: 4 - x² > 0.
Solve the quadratic inequality: x² + 4x + 4 > 0 and describe the exceptional solution set.
Solve the quadratic inequality: x² - 6x + 9 ≤ 0.
Solve the quadratic inequality: x² + 2x + 5 > 0 by analyzing the discriminant and leading coefficient.
Solve the quadratic inequality: -2x² + 3x - 5 ≥ 0.
Solve the quadratic inequality: (x - 3)(x + 4)(x - 1)² ≤ 0 using critical values on the number line.
Solve the rational inequality related to quadratic factors: (x - 2) / (x² - 9) ≥ 0.
Solve the inequality: (x² - 4x + 3) / (x + 2) < 0.
A rectangular banner has a length 3 meters longer than its width. If the area must be at least 40 m², find the range of possible widths.
The height h (in meters) of a projectile is given by h(t) = -5t² + 30t. For what time interval is the projectile at least 25 meters above the ground?
A manufacturing firm finds that its profit P(x) from producing x thousand items is P(x) = -x² + 14x - 40 (in thousands of pesos). For what production levels is the company profitable (P(x) > 0)?
Find the domain of the function f(x) = √(x² - 8x + 12).
Find the domain of the function g(x) = 1 / √(25 - x²).
Define a quadratic inequality in two variables and list its standard forms (e.g., y > ax² + bx + c).
Explain how to determine whether the boundary parabola of a quadratic inequality in two variables is solid or dashed.
Explain how to use a test point (such as the origin (0, 0)) to determine which region to shade for y ≤ x² - 4x + 3.
Graph the quadratic inequality in two variables: y > x² - 2x - 3.
Graph the quadratic inequality in two variables: y ≤ -x² + 4.
Graph the quadratic inequality in two variables: y ≥ 2x² + 4x - 6.
Determine whether the ordered pairs (0, 0), (2, -1), (-3, 5), and (1, 4) satisfy the inequality y < x² - 3x + 2.
Graph the system of inequalities consisting of a linear and a quadratic inequality: { y ≥ x² - 4 ; y ≤ x + 2 }.
Find the region of solutions for the system: { y < -x² + 6 ; y > 2x - 2 } and determine two integer coordinates in the solution set.
Graph the system of quadratic inequalities: { y ≥ x² - 1 ; y ≤ 5 - x² }.
Find the intersection points of the boundary curves in Question 30 by solving x² - 1 = 5 - x².
Graph the system of inequalities: { y ≥ (x - 2)² - 1 ; x + y < 5 ; y ≥ 0 }.
A sports ball's trajectory is bounded above by y ≤ -0.05x² + 2x + 1 and must clear a 10-meter fence. Set up and solve the inequality to find where the ball is above 10 meters.
For what values of k does the quadratic equation x² - kx + (k + 3) = 0 have no real roots? (Solve discriminant inequality D < 0).
Find all values of m for which the quadratic equation mx² + 4x + (m - 3) = 0 has two distinct real roots.
Find the values of c such that the quadratic function f(x) = x² - 6x + c is strictly positive for all real x.
Solve the double quadratic inequality: 3 ≤ x² - 2x ≤ 8.
Solve the inequality: x(x - 2) ≥ 8.
Solve the inequality: (2x - 1)² < (x + 4)².
A farmer wants to fence a rectangular garden with at most 60 meters of fence. If the area must be at least 200 m², find the permissible range of the garden length.
Explain why multiplying or dividing both sides of an inequality by a negative variable quantity requires splitting into cases.
Solve the inequality: x + (12 / x) ≤ 7.
Solve the inequality: (x² + 1) / (x² - 4) > 0.
Determine the solution set of: |x² - 5x| < 6.
Determine the solution set of: |x² - 4| ≥ 5.
Graph the solution set of y > x² on the Cartesian plane and describe the region in words.
Graph the solution set of y ≤ 9 - x² and x ≥ 0.
A rectangular swimming pool is to be built with a perimeter of 50 m. If the surface area must exceed 150 m², determine the allowable range of width.
Solve the system of quadratic inequalities: { x² + y² ≤ 25 ; y ≥ x² - 5 }.
A rocket altitude model requires h(t) = -4.9t² + 49t + 10 ≥ 100 meters. Solve for the time interval during which the rocket stays at or above 100 meters.

T06.topic_name: Absolute value equations and inequalities in one variable and their graphs
T06.competency: Solve absolute value equations in one variable; solve absolute value inequalities in one variable; express solutions across notations; graph absolute value functions and inequality solution sets.

questions.suggested_question: Define the absolute value of a real number |x| algebraically and geometrically as a distance on the number line.
State the fundamental property: |x| = a (where a > 0) is equivalent to x = a or x = -a.
Solve the absolute value equation: |2x - 5| = 9.
Solve the absolute value equation: |3x + 7| = 22.
Solve the equation: 4|x - 3| + 5 = 29.
Solve the equation: -2|5x - 1| + 8 = -14.
Explain why the absolute value equation |3x - 8| = -5 has no solution.
Solve the equation with absolute value on both sides: |2x + 3| = |x - 5|.
Solve the equation: |4x - 7| = |4x + 3|.
Solve the equation: |x² - 7| = 9.
Solve the equation: |x² - 3x| = 4.
Solve the equation with extraneous solutions: |2x - 1| = 3x + 4 and check both proposed roots.
Solve the equation: |x + 6| = 2x - 3 and verify valid solutions.
State the property for 'less than' absolute value inequalities: |x| < a ⇔ -a < x < a (where a > 0).
State the property for 'greater than' absolute value inequalities: |x| > a ⇔ x < -a or x > a (where a > 0).
Solve and graph on a number line: |x - 4| < 7.
Solve and express in interval notation: |2x + 5| ≤ 13.
Solve the inequality: |3x - 2| > 10 and graph the union of rays on a number line.
Solve the inequality: |4x + 1| ≥ 17.
Solve the inequality: 3|x - 2| + 4 < 19.
Solve the inequality: -2|3x + 1| - 5 ≥ -17.
Explain the solution set of |2x - 7| > -3 without algebraic manipulation.
Explain the solution set of |5x + 4| ≤ -2.
Solve the absolute value inequality: |(2x - 3) / 5| ≤ 3.
Solve the inequality: |(3x + 2) / 4| > 2.

A machine manufactures steel rods with an ideal length of 120 cm. A rod is acceptable if its length differs from ideal by at most 0.05 cm. Write and solve an absolute value inequality for acceptable length L.
The temperature in a climate-controlled greenhouse is maintained at 24°C with a tolerance of ±2.5°C. Write an absolute value inequality and find the allowable temperature range.
A cereal box is advertised as containing 500 grams. Quality control rejects any box where |w - 500| > 8 grams. What box weights are rejected?
Solve the absolute value inequality involving quadratic expressions: |x² - 4| < 5.
Solve the inequality: |x² - 2x - 3| ≥ 5.
Write the interval [-3, 11] as a single absolute value inequality of the form |x - c| ≤ r.
Write the union of intervals (-∞, -8) ∪ (4, ∞) as an absolute value inequality of the form |x - c| > r.
Find the center c and radius r of the tolerance interval represented by |x - 7.5| ≤ 1.2.
Solve the double absolute value inequality: 2 < |x - 3| ≤ 6 and graph the solution set.
Solve the equation: |x - 2| + |x - 5| = 7 by dividing the real line into three intervals: x < 2, 2 ≤ x ≤ 5, and x > 5.
Solve the equation: |x + 3| + |x - 1| = 4.
Solve the equation: |2x - 4| - |x + 1| = 3.
Graph the function f(x) = |x - 3| - 2 on the Cartesian plane and identify its vertex, axis of symmetry, domain, and range.
Graph the function g(x) = -2|x + 1| + 4 and determine its x-intercepts and y-intercept.
Solve the inequality: |x - 3| < 2x - 1 algebraically and graphically.
Find all real solutions to x² - 5|x| + 6 = 0.
Solve the equation: x² + 2|x| - 8 = 0.
Solve the inequality: |x / (x - 2)| ≥ 3.
Solve the inequality: |(x + 1) / (x - 1)| < 1.
State the Triangle Inequality for real numbers: |a + b| ≤ |a| + |b| and verify it for a = 4, b = -7.
Determine when equality holds in the Triangle Inequality: |a + b| = |a| + |b|.
Solve the equation: |3x - 6| = 0.
Solve the inequality: |4x - 12| ≤ 0.
An aircraft altimeter has an accuracy error modeled by |h_measured - h_actual| ≤ 15 meters. If the measured altitude is 3,200 m, find the range of actual altitude.
Solve the system of absolute value inequalities: { |x - 2| ≤ 4 ; |x + 1| > 2 }.

T07.competency: Illustrate laws of rational exponents; simplify radical expressions; perform operations and rationalize denominators; solve radical equations and applied formulas.

questions.suggested_question: State the definition of a rational exponent: x^(m/n) = ⁿ√(xᵐ) = (ⁿ√x)ᵐ where n is a positive integer.
Convert the following expressions with rational exponents into radical form: a) x^(3/4), b) (5a)^(2/3), c) 8^(2/3).
Convert the following radical expressions into exponential form: a) ∛(x⁵), b) ⁵√(32a³b⁴), c) √(7xy³).
State the Product Rule for radicals: ⁿ√(ab) = ⁿ√a · ⁿ√b and the Quotient Rule: ⁿ√(a/b) = ⁿ√a / ⁿ√b.
Simplify the radical expression completely: √(72x⁵y⁶).
Simplify the radical expression: ∛(54a⁷b¹¹).
Simplify the radical expression: ⁴√(162x⁹y¹⁴).
Simplify the radical expression: ⁵√(96m¹²n²³).
Perform the addition/subtraction of like radicals: 3√50 - 2√18 + 5√32.
Simplify: 2x√(27xy²) - 5y√(12x³y) + 3√(75x³y³).
Multiply and simplify: (2√3)(5√6).
Multiply and simplify: 3√2(4√6 - 2√10).
Expand and simplify the product of two binomial radical expressions: (3√2 - 2√5)(4√2 + 3√5).
Expand and simplify: (2√3 + 5√2)².
Expand and simplify: (4√7 - 3√2)(4√7 + 3√2).
Define what it means to rationalize the denominator of a radical fraction.
Rationalize the denominator: 6 / √3.
Rationalize the denominator: 10 / √(5x).
Rationalize the denominator of the cube root: 4 / ∛2.
Rationalize the denominator: 6 / ∛(9x²).
Define the conjugate of a binomial radical expression and rationalize the denominator of: 4 / (3 - √5).
Rationalize the denominator: (2 + √3) / (4 - √3).
Rationalize the denominator: (√6 - √2) / (√6 + √2).
Rationalize the denominator: 12 / (2√5 - 3√2).
Simplify the complex radical fraction: [ (1 / √2) + (1 / √3) ] / [ (1 / √2) - (1 / √3) ].
Solve the radical equation: √(2x + 7) = 5.
Solve the radical equation: ∛(3x - 4) = 2.
Solve the radical equation: √(4x + 9) - x = 3 and identify any extraneous roots.
Solve the radical equation: √(2x + 3) = x.
Solve the radical equation: √(x + 5) + √(x - 3) = 4.
Solve the radical equation: √(2x + 5) - √(x - 1) = 2.
Solve the radical equation: √(3x + 1) = 1 + √(x + 4).
Explain why extraneous roots can arise when both sides of an equation are raised to an even power.
Solve the radical equation: ⁴√(x² + 7) = 2.
The period T (in seconds) of a simple pendulum of length L (in meters) is given by T = 2π√(L / 9.8). Find the pendulum length L for a period of 2 seconds.
The speed of a tsunami v (in m/s) is related to ocean depth d (in meters) by v = √(9.8d). Find the ocean depth if a tsunami travels at 200 m/s.
The distance d (in miles) to the horizon from an altitude h (in feet) is approximated by d = √(1.5h). How high must an observer be to see 30 miles away?
Simplify the nested radical: √(7 + 2√10) by finding two numbers that add to 7 and multiply to 10.
Simplify the nested radical: √(14 - 6√5).
Simplify the radical expression with fractional exponents: (x^(1/2) · y^(-2/3)) / (x^(-1/4) · y^(1/3)).
Solve the equation with rational exponents: (2x - 3)^(2/3) = 9.
Solve the equation: (x + 2)^(3/4) = 8.
If x = 2 + √3, evaluate the value of x + (1/x) and x² + (1/x²).
Prove that (√a + √b)² = a + b + 2√(ab) for non-negative real numbers a and b.
Solve the radical inequality: √(3x - 6) ≤ 3.
Solve the radical inequality: √(2x + 8) > x.
Express the following in simplest radical form: ∛(x · √(x)).

T08.topic_name: The roots of a quadratic equation
T08.competency: Determine the nature of roots using the discriminant; apply Vieta's formulas relating roots and coefficients; construct quadratic equations given roots or conditions; solve problems.

questions.suggested_question: State the general quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0 and define the discriminant D = b² - 4ac.
State the four cases for the nature of the roots based on the value of the discriminant D: a) D > 0 (perfect square), b) D > 0 (not perfect square), c) D = 0, d) D < 0.
Determine the discriminant and describe the nature of the roots of: x² - 6x + 9 = 0.
Determine the discriminant and describe the nature of the roots of: 2x² - 5x - 3 = 0.
Determine the discriminant and describe the nature of the roots of: 3x² + 4x + 2 = 0.
Determine the discriminant and describe the nature of the roots of: 4x² - 12x + 7 = 0.
Find the value(s) of k such that the equation x² + kx + 25 = 0 has exactly one real (repeated) root.
Find the value(s) of p such that 3x² - 6x + p = 0 has equal roots.
Find the range of values of k for which 2x² - 4x + k = 0 has two distinct real roots.
Find the range of values of m for which x² + 6x + m = 0 has non-real (complex) roots.
State Vieta's formulas for a quadratic equation: Sum of roots r₁ + r₂ = -b/a and Product of roots r₁ · r₂ = c/a.
Without solving, find the sum and product of the roots of: 3x² - 15x + 7 = 0.
Without solving, find the sum and product of the roots of: 5x² + 8x - 11 = 0.
Form a quadratic equation in standard form with integer coefficients whose roots are 5 and -8.
Form a quadratic equation whose roots are 3/4 and -2/3.
Form a quadratic equation whose roots are 4 + √7 and 4 - √7.
Form a quadratic equation whose roots are 2 + 3i and 2 - 3i.
If the roots of 2x² - 7x + 3 = 0 are r₁ and r₂, calculate the value of: a) r₁² + r₂², b) (1/r₁) + (1/r₂).
If the roots of x² - 6x + 4 = 0 are α and β, evaluate: a) α³ + β³, b) (α/β) + (β/α).
If one root of the quadratic equation x² - kx + 18 = 0 is twice the other root, find the value of k and both roots.
If one root of 3x² + kx - 24 = 0 is -4, find the value of k and the other root.
If the difference between the two roots of x² - 8x + c = 0 is 4, find the value of c.
The roots of the equation x² - px + q = 0 differ by 1. Prove that p² = 4q + 1.
Find a quadratic equation whose roots are each 3 greater than the roots of 2x² - 5x + 1 = 0.
Find a quadratic equation whose roots are the squares of the roots of x² - 4x + 2 = 0.
Find a quadratic equation whose roots are the reciprocals of the roots of 3x² - 7x + 5 = 0.
Determine the value of k such that the sum of the roots of kx² - (k + 3)x + 12 = 0 is equal to their product.
Solve the quadratic equation by factoring: 6x² - 11x - 10 = 0.
Solve the quadratic equation by completing the square: 2x² - 8x + 3 = 0.
Solve the quadratic equation using the quadratic formula: 3x² - 5x - 1 = 0.
Determine whether the quadratic equation (k + 1)x² - 2(k - 1)x + 1 = 0 has real roots for all real values of k.
For what values of a does the equation (a - 2)x² + 2ax + (a + 3) = 0 have equal roots?
If the roots of ax² + bx + c = 0 are real and rational, what condition must b² - 4ac satisfy assuming a, b, c are rational?
Prove that if a, b, c are odd integers, the quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0 cannot have rational roots.
If the discriminant of ax² + bx + c = 0 is zero, explain the geometric relationship between the graph of y = ax² + bx + c and the x-axis.
If the discriminant is negative, describe the visual position of the parabola y = ax² + bx + c relative to the x-axis when a > 0.
Write a quadratic equation whose roots are sin 30° and cos 60°.
Write a quadratic equation whose roots are tan 45° and tan 60°.
If r₁ and r₂ are the roots of x² - 5x + 6 = 0, construct the equation whose roots are (2r₁ + 1) and (2r₂ + 1).
Show that the roots of the equation x² - 2px + (p² - q²) = 0 are p + q and p - q.
Find the condition on constants p and q such that the roots of x² + px + q = 0 are in the ratio 1 : 3.
If the sum of the roots of ax² + bx + c = 0 is equal to the sum of the squares of the roots, show that 2ac = ab + b².
Find all values of k such that the roots of x² - (k - 2)x + (k² - 4) = 0 are opposite in sign and equal in magnitude (sum of roots = 0).
Find all values of k such that one root of x² - 8x + k = 0 is zero.
If both roots of x² - 4x + k = 0 are positive, determine the range of values for k.
If both roots of x² + 6x + c = 0 are negative, determine the range of values for c.
Solve the quadratic equation involving complex roots: 2x² - 4x + 5 = 0.
If α and β are the roots of 2x² + 3x - 7 = 0, form the quadratic equation with roots 1/α² and 1/β².
Explain how the sign of c/a determines whether the roots of a quadratic equation have the same sign or opposite signs.
A ball's trajectory is modeled by h(t) = -5t² + 18t + 8. Use the quadratic formula to find when the ball hits the ground (h = 0).

T09.competency: Determine equations of quadratic functions from tables, graphs, and zeros; analyze vertex, axis of symmetry, min/max; transform forms; solve optimization and contextual problems.

questions.suggested_question: Determine the equation of a quadratic function f(x) = ax² + bx + c given a table of values: (0, 3), (1, 6), (2, 11), (3, 18).
Determine the equation of the quadratic function passing through (-1, 8), (0, 3), and (2, 5).
Find the quadratic function whose vertex is at (3, -4) and which passes through the point (1, 4).
Find the quadratic function whose vertex is at (-2, 5) and whose y-intercept is (0, -3).
Determine the quadratic function in factored form given its zeros x = -3 and x = 5, and passing through (1, -16).
Find the quadratic function with zeros at x = 2/3 and x = -4, passing through (2, 32).
From a given parabolic graph with axis of symmetry x = 1, maximum value 9, and x-intercept (4, 0), find the equation of the quadratic function.
Convert the standard form quadratic function f(x) = 2x² - 12x + 11 into vertex form f(x) = a(x - h)² + k.
Convert the vertex form f(x) = -3(x + 2)² + 15 into standard polynomial form.
Find the axis of symmetry, vertex coordinates, and opening direction of f(x) = -4x² + 16x - 7.
Determine the maximum or minimum value of the quadratic function f(x) = 3x² - 18x + 25 and the value of x at which it occurs.
Determine the domain and range of the function f(x) = -2(x - 5)² + 18.
Find the intervals on which the quadratic function f(x) = x² - 6x + 8 is increasing and decreasing.
Find the x-intercepts and y-intercept of the quadratic function f(x) = 2x² + 3x - 14.
A revenue function from selling x items is R(x) = -2x² + 120x. Find the number of items x that maximizes revenue and determine maximum revenue.
A manufacturer models unit production cost as C(x) = 0.05x² - 20x + 3000, where x is the number of units produced. Find the production level that minimizes cost.
A farmer has 160 meters of fencing to create a rectangular corral divided into two equal compartments by a fence parallel to one side. Find the dimensions that maximize total area.
A projectile is fired upward from a platform 20 meters high with an initial velocity of 40 m/s. Its height is h(t) = -5t² + 40t + 20. Find its maximum height and time to reach it.
Referring to Question 18, determine when the projectile hits the ground.

A travel agency charges ₱2,000 per person for a tour with a minimum of 30 people. For every additional person beyond 30, the price per person is reduced by ₱40. Find the group size that maximizes agency revenue.
Find two numbers whose sum is 36 and whose product is a maximum.
Find two numbers whose difference is 14 such that their product is a minimum.
The sum of the base and height of a triangle is 24 cm. Find the dimensions that maximize the triangle's area.
A rectangular window frame has a perimeter of 12 meters. What dimensions will admit the maximum amount of light?
Describe the sequence of transformations that maps the parent function y = x² onto f(x) = -(1/2)(x + 4)² - 6.
Describe how parameter 'a' affects the steepness and opening direction of f(x) = ax².
Describe how parameter 'k' affects the vertical translation of f(x) = x² + k.
Describe how parameter 'h' affects the horizontal translation of f(x) = (x - h)².
Find the quadratic function whose graph is a reflection of y = 2(x - 3)² + 4 across the x-axis.
Find the quadratic function whose graph is a reflection of y = 2(x - 3)² + 4 across the y-axis.

A suspension bridge main cable hangs in the shape of a parabola between two 30-meter towers spaced 120 meters apart. If the lowest point of the cable is 6 meters above the roadway, find the equation of the parabola.
A parabolic satellite dish has a diameter of 1.2 meters and a depth of 0.2 meters. Set up the quadratic equation modeling the cross-section.
A skateboard half-pipe is shaped like a parabola 3 meters high and 8 meters wide at the top. Write the quadratic function representing the half-pipe profile.
Find the equation of the line tangent to the parabola y = x² - 4x + 5 at the point (3, 2).
Find the point of intersection between the line y = 2x - 1 and the parabola y = x² - 3x + 3.
Find the value(s) of m for which the line y = mx - 4 is tangent to the parabola y = x² - 2x.
A store sells 100 shirts per week at ₱300 each. Market research shows that for each ₱20 price increase, 5 fewer shirts are sold. Formulate the revenue function and find the optimal selling price.
Given f(x) = x² - 4x + k, find k such that the minimum value of the function is -9.
Given f(x) = -x² + 2kx + 7, find k such that the maximum value of the function is 16.
Find the coordinates of the vertex of f(x) = ax² + bx + c by completing the square in general terms.
A parabolic water stream from a fountain reaches a maximum height of 4 meters at a horizontal distance of 2 meters from the nozzle. Find where the stream lands on the ground.
Explain why the axis of symmetry always passes through the midpoint between the two x-intercepts of a parabola.
Find the quadratic function that satisfies f(1) = 0, f(2) = -3, and f(-1) = 12.
Determine the average rate of change of f(x) = 2x² - 3x + 1 over the interval [1, 4].
Compare the average rate of change of f(x) = x² on [0, 2] versus [2, 4] and interpret what this indicates about parabolic curvature.
Graph f(x) = -x² + 4x + 5 by finding its vertex, axis of symmetry, intercepts, and a symmetric table of points.
Find the range of the quadratic function f(x) = 4x² - 16x + 9.
A rectangle has a perimeter of 40 cm. Write the area A as a function of its width w, sketch the graph of A(w), and identify the vertex.
Determine if the quadratic function f(x) = -3x² + 12x - 15 has real zeros by computing its discriminant.
A tunnel arch is modeled by y = -0.4x² + 4, where x and y are in meters. Can a truck 2.5 meters wide and 3 meters tall pass safely through the tunnel?

T10.competency: Identify equations reducible to quadratic form; solve biquadratic, rational, radical, exponential, trigonometric, and reciprocal equations using algebraic substitution.

Solve the equation: (x² + 2x)² - 11(x² + 2x) + 24 = 0.
Solve the equation: (x² - 5x + 7)² - (x - 2)(x - 3) = 1.

Solve the trigonometric equation: 2 cos² θ + cos θ - 1 = 0 for 0° ≤ θ ≤ 360°.
Solve the trigonometric equation: tan² θ - (√3 + 1) tan θ + √3 = 0 for 0° ≤ θ < 360°.
Solve the equation: (x + 1/x)² - 3(x + 1/x) + 2 = 0.
Solve the reciprocal polynomial equation: 2x⁴ + x³ - 6x² + x + 2 = 0 by dividing by x² and setting u = x + 1/x.
Solve the symmetric equation: x⁴ - 4x³ + 5x² - 4x + 1 = 0.
Solve the equation: 6x⁴ - 35x³ + 62x² - 35x + 6 = 0.
Solve the absolute value equation reducible to quadratic form: x² - 4|x| + 3 = 0.
Solve the absolute value equation: 2x² - 5|x| - 3 = 0.
Solve the equation: (x - 2)⁴ - 5(x - 2)² + 4 = 0.
Solve the equation: (2x + 3)⁴ - 10(2x + 3)² + 9 = 0.
A rectangular swimming pool has an area of 200 m². If length is doubled and width is increased by 5 m, the new area is 600 m². Set up and solve the resulting quadratic-reducible system.
Two pipes together fill a tank in 12 hours. If one pipe takes 10 hours longer than the other alone, set up the rational equation and solve for the individual fill times.
A boat travels 24 km upstream and 24 km downstream in a total time of 5 hours. If the river current flows at 2 km/h, set up and solve the equation for the boat's speed in still water.
A group of friends agreed to share the ₱1,800 cost of a cottage equally. When 3 friends joined the group, each person's share decreased by ₱20. Find the original group size.
Solve the system of equations reducible to quadratic form: { x + y = 7 ; x² + y² = 25 }.
Solve the system: { xy = 12 ; x² + y² = 25 }.
Solve the system: { 2x² - y² = 7 ; x² + 3y² = 28 } using substitution u = x² and v = y².
Solve the logarithmic equation reducible to quadratic form: (log₂ x)² - log₂ (x³) + 2 = 0.
Solve the equation: √(x / (1 - x)) + √((1 - x) / x) = 13/6.

T11.topic_name: Equation of a circle and the graph of a circle
T11.competency: Transform between center-radius form and general form; determine center and radius; sketch graphs; find equations from geometric conditions; solve circle problems in the Cartesian plane.

questions.suggested_question: State the definition of a circle as a geometric locus in the Cartesian plane.
State the standard center-radius form of the equation of a circle: (x - h)² + (y - k)² = r².
State the general form of the equation of a circle: x² + y² + Dx + Ey + F = 0.
Write the standard equation of a circle with center at the origin (0, 0) and radius r = 7.
Write the standard equation of a circle with center C(3, -5) and radius r = 4.
Write the standard equation of a circle with center C(-4, 2) and radius r = 3√2.
Determine the center (h, k) and radius r of the circle: (x - 6)² + (y + 1)² = 49.
Determine the center and radius of the circle: (x + 2)² + y² = 18.
Transform the circle equation from center-radius form (x - 3)² + (y + 4)² = 25 to general form x² + y² + Dx + Ey + F = 0.
Transform (x + 5)² + (y - 2)² = 16 to general form.
Transform the general form equation x² + y² - 6x + 8y - 11 = 0 into center-radius form by completing the square.
Find the center and radius of the circle given by: x² + y² + 4x - 10y + 13 = 0.
Find the center and radius of the circle: 2x² + 2y² - 8x + 12y - 6 = 0.
Determine the center and radius of: x² + y² - 12x - 4y + 40 = 0.
Explain what geometric figure is represented by x² + y² - 4x + 6y + 13 = 0 (point circle / degenerate circle).
Explain what is represented by x² + y² + 2x - 4y + 10 = 0 (imaginary circle / empty set).
Find the equation of the circle having the line segment connecting A(-2, 5) and B(4, -3) as its diameter.
Find the equation of the circle with diameter endpoints P(1, 4) and Q(7, -2).
Find the equation of the circle with center at (2, -3) that passes through the point (5, 1).
Find the equation of the circle with center at (-1, 4) and tangent to the x-axis.
Find the equation of the circle with center at (3, -2) and tangent to the y-axis.
Find the equation of the circle with center at (4, 3) and tangent to the line 3x + 4y - 4 = 0.
Find the equation of the circle passing through the three points (0, 0), (6, 0), and (0, 8).
Find the equation of the circle passing through (1, 1), (2, 4), and (5, 3).
Determine whether the point (3, 4) lies inside, outside, or on the circle (x - 1)² + (y + 2)² = 36.
Determine the position of the points P(2, 1), Q(0, 5), and R(4, -3) relative to the circle x² + y² - 4x + 2y - 20 = 0.
Find the x-intercepts and y-intercepts of the circle (x - 2)² + (y + 1)² = 25.
Find the intercepts of the circle x² + y² - 8x - 6y + 9 = 0 on both coordinate axes.
Sketch the graph of the circle (x + 3)² + (y - 2)² = 16 clearly indicating its center, radius, and four cardinal boundary points.
Find the equation of the tangent line to the circle x² + y² = 25 at the point (3, 4).
Find the equation of the tangent line to the circle (x - 2)² + (y + 1)² = 25 at the point (5, 3).
Find the length of the tangent segment drawn from the external point P(8, 6) to the circle x² + y² = 25.
Find the length of the tangent segment from P(-3, 7) to the circle x² + y² - 4x + 6y - 12 = 0.
Determine the points of intersection between the circle x² + y² = 25 and the line x - y + 1 = 0.
Determine the points of intersection between the circle (x - 1)² + (y - 2)² = 10 and the line y = 2x + 1.
Show that the line 3x - 4y + 25 = 0 is tangent to the circle x² + y² = 25 and find the point of tangency.
Find the value(s) of k such that the line y = x + k is tangent to the circle x² + y² = 18.
Find the points of intersection of the two circles: C₁: x² + y² = 25 and C₂: x² + y² - 6x - 8y + 9 = 0.
Find the equation of the common chord (radical axis) of the circles x² + y² - 4x - 6y + 4 = 0 and x² + y² + 2x - 4y - 6 = 0.
Determine whether the two circles (x - 3)² + (y - 1)² = 16 and (x + 2)² + (y - 1)² = 9 are externally tangent, internally tangent, intersecting, or non-intersecting.
Two circles have equations (x - 1)² + (y - 2)² = 25 and (x - 7)² + (y - 10)² = 9. Calculate the distance between their centers and determine their relative position.
A cellular network tower has a broadcast coverage circle modeled by x² + y² - 8x - 10y + 16 = 0 (1 unit = 1 km). Find the tower location (center) and broadcast range (radius).
Referring to Question 42, determine whether a user at coordinates (7, 9) receives the cell signal.
An earthquake epicenter is located at coordinates (3, -2). The tremor is felt within a radius of 45 km. Write the inequality representing the affected geographic zone.
A circular rotary (roundabout) is modeled by x² + y² = 400 (in meters). An approaching road follows the tangent line at (12, 16). Write the equation of the road.
Find the equation of the circle concentric with x² + y² - 6x + 4y - 12 = 0 and having a radius twice as large.
Find the equation of the circle with radius 5 that is tangent to both coordinate axes in the second quadrant.
Find the equation of the circle passing through (2, 3) and tangent to both axes in the first quadrant.
Prove using coordinate geometry that the angle inscribed in a semicircle of x² + y² = r² is a right angle.
Find the locus of a point P(x, y) that moves such that the ratio of its distances from A(-2, 0) and B(4, 0) is 1 : 2 (Circle of Apollonius).

T12.topic_name: Simple interest, compound interest, and depreciation
T12.competency: Explore simple and compound interest; calculate compound interest by repeated applications and formulas; analyze compounding frequencies; solve real-life compound interest and depreciation problems.

questions.suggested_question: Define simple interest and state its formula: I = P · r · t, explaining each variable.
Calculate the simple interest and maturity value on a principal of ₱45,000 invested at an annual interest rate of 6% for 3 years.
A loan of ₱80,000 charged simple interest of ₱14,400 over 4 years. Calculate the annual interest rate.
How many years will it take for a deposit of ₱25,000 to earn ₱7,500 in simple interest at an annual rate of 5%?
Define compound interest and explain how it differs conceptually from simple interest.
State the compound interest formula for compounding m times per year: A = P(1 + r/m)^(m·t).
Explain the meaning of nominal interest rate versus effective annual rate (EAR / APY).
Demonstrate compound interest by repeated applications of simple interest year-by-year for ₱10,000 invested at 8% compounded annually for 3 years.
Calculate the maturity value (future value) and total compound interest earned on ₱50,000 invested at 6% compounded annually for 5 years.
Calculate the compound amount on ₱30,000 invested at 8% compounded semi-annually (m = 2) for 4 years.
Calculate the maturity value on ₱20,000 invested at 12% compounded quarterly (m = 4) for 3 years.
Calculate the maturity value on ₱15,000 invested at 9% compounded monthly (m = 12) for 2.5 years.
Compare the total compound interest earned on ₱100,000 invested at 6% for 5 years when compounded: a) annually, b) quarterly, c) monthly.
Find the present value (principal P) that must be invested today at 7% compounded quarterly to accumulate to ₱120,000 in 6 years.
How much money should parents invest in a college fund at 8% compounded monthly to have ₱500,000 when their child turns 18 (in 15 years)?
Using the Rule of 72, approximate the number of years required for an investment to double at an annual interest rate of 9%.
Calculate the exact doubling time for an investment growing at 6% compounded annually using logarithms.
Find the effective annual rate (EAR) equivalent to a nominal rate of 10% compounded quarterly.
Which investment option yields a higher return: Option A offering 7.8% compounded monthly, or Option B offering 8.0% compounded semi-annually?
Define depreciation and explain straight-line depreciation versus reducing-balance (declining balance) depreciation.
State the reducing-balance depreciation formula: V(t) = P(1 - r)^t.
A delivery van was purchased for ₱1,200,000. If it depreciates at an annual rate of 15% on a declining balance, calculate its book value after 4 years.
Calculate the total depreciation loss on a computer system bought for ₱85,000 that depreciates at 20% per year after 3 years.
A piece of heavy industrial machinery bought for ₱2,500,000 has a salvage value of ₱400,000 after 10 years using straight-line depreciation. Calculate the annual depreciation expense.
A motorcycle depreciates by 12% each year. If its current value is ₱68,000, find its original purchase price 3 years ago.
How many years will it take for a vehicle purchased for ₱900,000 to depreciate to half its original value at a reducing rate of 10% per year?
A company buys office furniture for ₱150,000. The furniture depreciates at 18% per year. Find its value after 5 years.
An investor deposits ₱5,000 at the end of each month into an annuity account paying 6% compounded monthly. Calculate the future value of the ordinary annuity after 4 years.
A person borrows ₱250,000 to start a small business. The loan is to be repaid in equal monthly installments over 3 years at 10% interest compounded monthly. Calculate the monthly payment.
Explain continuous compounding and state the formula A = P·e^(rt). Calculate the maturity value of ₱40,000 invested at 7% compounded continuously for 5 years.
Calculate the compound interest on ₱60,000 at 10% per annum for 1.5 years compounded semi-annually.
A bank offers two credit card repayment plans. Explain why compounding interest monthly on unpaid balances leads to rapid debt accumulation.
If inflation averages 4.5% per year, what will be the purchasing power of ₱100,000 after 10 years?
A rare vintage car appreciates in value at a rate of 8% per year. If it is currently worth ₱1,500,000, find its projected value in 6 years.
Determine the annual compounding rate r required for ₱50,000 to grow to ₱80,000 in 5 years.
A commercial printer costs ₱350,000 and has an estimated useful life of 8 years with a scrap value of ₱30,000. Calculate its book value after 3 years using straight-line depreciation.
Explain how a spreadsheet schedule can be constructed to track the amortized payments, interest portion, principal reduction, and remaining loan balance.
A cooperative offers a dividend of 9% compounded annually. If a member maintains ₱75,000 in share capital for 6 years, find the total earnings.
Calculate the difference between simple interest and compound interest on ₱200,000 invested at 8% per annum for 3 years.
A business owner takes a short-term promissory note of ₱50,000 discounted at 8% simple discount for 9 months. Find the proceeds received by the borrower.
Find the accumulated value of ₱10,000 invested for 3 years at 6% compounded semi-annually for the first year, and 8% compounded quarterly for the remaining two years.
An electronic device depreciates 30% in its first year and 15% per year for each subsequent year. If its initial cost was ₱45,000, find its value after 3 years.
A savings bond matures to ₱100,000 in 10 years. If the interest rate is 5.5% compounded semi-annually, find its issue purchase price.
Explain the concept of capital growth vs income yield in long-term financial investments.
A mobile phone worth ₱35,000 loses 25% of its remaining value each year. Graph its depreciation curve over 5 years.
Determine how much interest is earned in the 3rd year alone for an investment of ₱50,000 at 7% compounded annually.
An individual wishes to have ₱1,000,000 at retirement in 20 years. If an investment account yields 9% compounded annually, calculate the single lump-sum deposit required today.
Find the annual depreciation rate of a factory asset that declines from ₱500,000 to ₱204,800 in 4 years on a reducing-balance basis.
A loan of ₱100,000 is settled with a single payment of ₱140,000 after 3 years. Find the nominal annual interest rate if interest was compounded quarterly.
Compare how simple interest grows linearly while compound interest grows exponentially over time.
